name: @pipeworx/mcp-close-crm

tools.name: close_me
tools.description: Get the current Close user and organization for the supplied API key. Returns user ID, name, email, and the organizations (with IDs) the key can access. Use this to verify the key works and discover your organization context.

tools.name: close_search_leads
tools.description: Search or list leads (companies/accounts in Close) using Close's query language. Returns a `data` array of leads (with id, display_name, contacts, status, custom fields) plus `has_more` and `total_results`. The `query` param accepts Close search syntax, e.g. `name:"Acme"`, `status_label:"Potential"`, `email_address:@example.com`, `lead_created_within:7d`, or free text. Omit `query` to list all leads. Page with `_limit` (max 200) and `_skip`.

query.description: Close query string. Examples: `name:"Acme Inc"`, `status_label:"Potential"`, `email_address:@acme.com`, `lead_created_within:30d`. Free text also works. Omit to list all leads.

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: close_get_lead
tools.description: Get a single lead by its Close lead ID (format `lead_...`). Returns full detail: display name, description, status, contacts, addresses, opportunities, custom fields, and timestamps.

tools.name: close_list_opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities (pipeline deals) in Close. Returns a `data` array of opportunities with id, lead_id, status, value, currency, confidence, and expected close date, plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Pass `lead_id` to scope to one lead, or omit to list across the organization. Page with `_limit` / `_skip`.

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to filter opportunities to a single lead

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: close_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) in Close. Returns a `data` array of contacts with id, lead_id, name, title, emails, and phones, plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Optionally filter to one lead with `lead_id`. Page with `_limit` / `_skip`.

lead_id.description: Optional lead ID to filter contacts to a single lead

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: close_list_activities
tools.description: List activities for a lead — calls, emails, notes, SMS, meetings, and status changes. Returns a `data` array (with id, _type, type, date_created, and type-specific fields) plus `has_more` / `total_results`. Requires `lead_id`. Page with `_limit` / `_skip` to walk a lead's timeline.

lead_id.description: Lead ID whose activity timeline to fetch

_skip.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default 0)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-close-crm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the close-crm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
